questions.question: Who sang “My Heart Will Go On,” the love theme from Titanic?
questions.note: James Horner wrote the music; Will Jennings wrote the lyrics. It won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

questions.question: Eminem’s “Lose Yourself” won Best Original Song from which 2002 film?
questions.note: The first rap song to win that Oscar. 8 Mile is loosely based on Eminem’s Detroit years.

questions.question: Who composed the scores for The Lord of the Rings films?
questions.note: Williams is Star Wars and the early Harry Potter films; Zimmer is Inception and The Lion King score.

questions.question: Who sang the title song for the James Bond film Skyfall?
questions.note: 2012. Smith sang Spectre’s “Writing’s on the Wall”; Eilish sang No Time to Die.

questions.question: Who composed the score for the first Harry Potter film?
questions.note: Hedwig’s Theme. Doyle took over for Goblet of Fire; Desplat scored the last two.

questions.question: Pharrell Williams’s hit “Happy” is from which 2013 animated sequel?
questions.note: It later got a 24-hour music video. The Minions steal a lot of the sequel.

questions.question: Wiz Khalifa and Charlie Puth’s “See You Again” is from which Fast & Furious film?
questions.note: 2015 — a tribute to Paul Walker, who died during production.

questions.question: Which 2010 sci-fi sequel has a score by Daft Punk?
questions.note: Joseph Kosinski directed; Jeff Bridges returns as Kevin Flynn.

questions.question: Which Pixar film features the song “Remember Me”?
questions.note: 2017, set on Día de los Muertos. It won Best Original Song.

questions.question: Which 2014 animated film includes the song “Everything Is Awesome”?
questions.note: Tegan and Sara with The Lonely Island. Chris Pratt voices Emmet.
